name: Grapes U-Pick
tagline: Ever After Farms U Pick Grape Vineyard
description: A family-run winery in Altoona, FL, Grapes U-Pick grows Grapes. The winery is busiest in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Oct in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
